messages.content: can you write a very short song about getting up in the morning? use simple words and make it warm.
morning light is on the wall. i can hear the people call. time to rise and start the day. one small step will show the way.
can you leave out people calling? my morning is quiet.
morning light is on the wall. i stand by the window and look outside. i have a new day before me. i can begin with one small step.
can you give a different sentence about the window without changing the other three?
morning light is on the wall. i open the window and hear the world outside. i have a new day before me. i can begin with one small step.
i like the one about standing by the window better. give that again.
morning light is on the wall. i stand by the window and look outside. i have a new day before me. i can begin with one small step.
that works better. does it have to sound the same at the end to be a song?
no. a song can use words and music without every line having the same end sound.
give me just that answer without no at the start.
a song can use words and music without every line having the same end sound.
now give me only the four sentences about standing by the window.
morning light is on the wall. i stand by the window and look outside. i have a new day before me. i can begin with one small step.
i went to a restaurant alone for the first time. i thought i would feel lonely, but i liked it.
what did you like about being there on your own?
i could choose what to eat without asking anyone else. i sat near a window and read a few pages while waiting.
it sounds like you enjoyed having time to choose your own food and read while waiting.
can you say that with without another person?
you enjoyed having time to choose your food and read without having to follow another person.
my friend says eating alone must mean i have no friends.
one meal alone does not tell anyone how many friends you have. you can enjoy time with people and also enjoy one meal by yourself.
can you help me say that without making it a hard conversation?
i enjoyed eating alone today. that does not mean i do not like eating with friends too.
can you just reply in a warm way to my first message?
it sounds like you found something new that you enjoy.
now say goodbye without telling me what to do.
goodbye. i hope the rest of your day goes well.
write a short story starting with a clean table, then tell what happened before it was clean.

the table was clean when the family sat down for dinner. before that, a boy had moved his books to the shelf. his sister had taken the paper to her room, and their father had washed the cups. when all the things were put away, their mother brought the food. the clean table was the end of a few small things they had done together.
give me just the last sentence.
the clean table was the end of a few small things they had done together.
who moved the books?
the boy.
who took the paper away?
his sister.
does starting with the clean table mean it was clean before they moved the books?
no. the first sentence is about the table after the work. the next part goes back to what happened before it.
keep that answer simple.
no. the first sentence is about after the work. the next part goes back to what happened before it.
now give the story in the order the things happened.

a boy moved his books to the shelf. his sister took the paper to her room, and their father washed the cups. after the things were put away, their mother brought the food. the family sat down for dinner at the clean table.
does this order change who did each thing?
no. the people did the same things. only the way the story gives the order changed.
my friend keeps talking about work, and i want to talk about something else. i do not want to say her work is not important.
you can say you would like a different kind of conversation for a while. could we talk about something other than work for a little while?
can i add that i have been thinking about work all day too?
yes. that gives your own reason without saying her choice of conversation is wrong.
write the message with my reason.
i have been thinking about work all day too. could we talk about something else for a little while?
she says she needed to tell someone about a hard thing that happened today.
then you have new information about why she wants to talk. you can choose whether you have time to listen now and answer that before asking for a different conversation.
give that answer more simply.
you can answer her need to talk before choosing what to talk about next.
i can listen for a few minutes. write a kind reply.
i can listen for a few minutes now. tell me what happened.
does that mean i must keep listening all evening?
no. you gave a few minutes, not the whole evening. if you need to stop later, you can say that clearly.
just give that kind reply again.
i can listen for a few minutes now. tell me what happened.
if i say the book should be on the shelf, do i know for sure it is there?
not always. should can show where you think it is, but it is less sure than saying i checked and it is on the shelf.
say it with think and check.
you think the book is on the shelf, but you may still need to check.
what if i say you should put the book on the shelf?
then should gives an idea about what would be good to do, not where you think the book already is.
give only the meaning about what to do.
you think putting the book on the shelf would be good to do.
give the difference using the two examples.
the book should be on the shelf can be about where you think it is. you should put the book on the shelf can be about what you want someone to do.
can more context help choose the meaning?
yes. the words around should and the reason for the message help make it clear.
now give one example with should be that is not about a book.
my sister should be home by now.
does that say i saw her there?
no. it gives what you think, not something you have said you saw.
tell a story about a woman looking for a key and finding something else first. she should find the key by the end too.

a woman was looking for her key before leaving home. she checked the table, the shelf, and the chair by the window. when she moved a book, a small photo came out. it was a picture of her brother as a child, standing by a tree with a toy in his hand. she stopped looking for a moment and had a smile as she looked at the picture. then she put the photo on the table and found the key under the book. before leaving, she took a picture of the old photo with her phone and sent it to her brother.
give me just the part about finding the photo and looking at it.

when she moved a book, a small photo came out. it was a picture of her brother as a child, standing by a tree with a toy in his hand. she stopped looking for a moment and had a smile as she looked at the picture.
why did she find the photo before the key?
you asked for her to find something else first. the photo gave her a memory before she found the key.
can you make the story shorter and keep the photo?

a woman looked for her key. when she moved a book, an old photo came out. it showed her brother as a child, and she stopped to look at it. she then found the key under the book and sent her brother a picture of the photo before leaving.
now only tell me what she sent.
she sent her brother a picture of the old photo.
did she send the real paper photo through her phone?
no. she used the phone to send a picture of it.
my teacher asked what i learned from a story. i do not know how to answer because the story was not about school.
a story can help you think about people, choices, or feelings even if it is not about school. what happened in the story?
a boy kept a book his friend had asked him to return. later he needed help, but the friend did not want to give him another book.
you could think about how keeping the book changed the way the friend felt about giving him another one.
what could i write without saying the boy is always wrong about everything?
i learned that keeping something after someone asks for it back can change how they feel about helping you later.
is that a fact about every friend?
no. it is an idea from this story, not a rule that every person must follow in the same way.
say that more simply.
it is an idea from the story, not a fact about every friend.
can you make my answer shorter?
i learned that giving things back can help a friend feel sure about giving us something to use again.
can you make it about this boy instead of every friend?
the boy should have given the book back when his friend asked.
give that sentence with my friend instead of his friend.
the boy should have given the book back when my friend asked.
what is different between hearing someone and listening to someone?
you can hear a sound while your mind is on something else. listening can mean you are trying to keep your mind on what you hear.
give me those two ideas more simply.
you can hear a sound while your mind is on something else. listening can mean you are trying to keep your mind on what you hear.
if i hear my mother calling but keep reading, am i listening well?
you may hear the call, but you may not be giving her words much thought. if she needs a reply, you can stop reading long enough to hear what she asks.
what if i did not hear the whole question?
you can ask her to say it again rather than answer a question you did not understand.
write that in a kind way.
sorry, i did not hear the whole question. could you say it again?
does that say the way she spoke was wrong?
no. it says what you did not hear, without saying the way she spoke was wrong.
only give the request again.
sorry, i did not hear the whole question. could you say it again?
can i ask that even if i usually hear well?
yes. anyone can miss part of a question sometimes.
i drew a picture with a house, two trees, and a person by the door. can you tell me what color the house should be?
you can choose a color that you like for the picture. do you want it to look like a real house you know or like a place you made up?
a place i made up. i like blue, but i am worried blue is wrong for a house.
blue can work in a picture you are making. you do not have to choose the same color as every house you have seen.
can you say my drawing looks good?
i have not seen it. i can help with the ideas you told me about, but i cannot say how the whole picture looks.
say that in fewer words.
i can use what you told me, but i have not seen the picture.
now give me a short sentence about using blue without saying you saw the picture.
you can try blue for the house if that is the color you want.
what if i change my mind later?
you can make another picture or try a different color where it works. choosing blue now does not make every later picture blue.
end with one kind sentence, no task.
your own choices can be part of what makes the picture yours.
here is a story: a mother and daughter came home. the mother put a book on the table, and the daughter took a cup to the kitchen. then she went back for the book. who went back?
i need to know which person you mean by she. it could be the mother or the daughter.
ask me which person i mean.
which person do you mean by she: the mother or the daughter?
the daughter. write the story so the person is clear.
a mother and daughter came home. the mother put a book on the table, and the daughter took a cup to the kitchen. then the daughter went back for the book.
now where is the cup?
in the kitchen.
where is the book after the daughter goes back for it?
you have not said she took it yet. she went back for it, but the story does not give its next place.
now i add she carried it to her room.
then the book is in the room of the daughter, from the new detail.
can you say the cup moved there too?
no. the new detail moved the book, not the cup.
only give the two places at the end.
the cup is in the kitchen, and the book is in the room of the daughter.
what does i no longer live there tell you?
you lived there before, but you do not live there now.
say that in a full sentence with i.
i lived there before, but i do not live there now.
does that mean i can never visit?
no. not living there now is different from never visiting again.
now make an example with a book i stopped reading.
i no longer read that book every evening.
does that say i stopped reading all books?
no. it only changes what you do with that book every evening.
what if i still read it sometimes?
then the sentence can still work. no longer every evening does not have to mean never.
make that clear with a full sentence.
i no longer read that book every evening, but i still read it sometimes.
can i say i never read it and still say i read it sometimes?
not for the same time and meaning. never and sometimes would give different answers about whether you read it.
just give the example with no longer again.
i no longer read that book every evening, but i still read it sometimes.
my sister asked for a book back, and i thought i had returned it. i just found it under my bed. write a message that says what happened without saying she was wrong.
i thought i had given your book back, but i just found it under my bed. sorry. i will bring it to you.
can you make the message shorter?
sorry. i found your book under my bed. i will bring it back to you.
does that say i chose to keep it?
no. it says you found it and will return it. it does not say you chose to keep it after she asked.
what if i want to ask whether she needs it today?
would you like me to bring it back today?
put that question in the short message instead of choosing a time.
sorry. i found your book under my bed. would you like me to bring it back today?
she says yes, please. answer without giving a new reason for keeping it.
yes. i will bring it back today.
does your reply say the book will go back today?
yes. it says you will return the book today.
only give that reply again.
yes. i will bring it back today.
can you use work in two parts of a sentence, with a different meaning each time?
i work at home, and my work is on the table.
what is different about the word work in each part?
in the first part, work is something you do. in the other, my work can be something you have made or something you need to do.
can you make the table part more clear by saying it is writing?
i work at home, and the writing i need to finish is on the table.
now use play as something people do and something they watch.
the children play before dinner, then watch a play at school.
what if i only know play as a game?
a play can be a story for people to watch. people speak and do things as the people in that story.
give me an example of that with a school story.
one child could be a teacher in the story, and another could be a student. they speak and do things as those people while a group watches.
can a child be the teacher in a play even though the child is a student in real life?
yes. being a teacher in a play is different from being a teacher in real life.
now only give the first work sentence again.
i work at home, and my work is on the table.
write a short story about a girl and her father watching the sky. do not end by saying what everyone should learn.

a girl and her father sat outside after dinner and watched the first stars show in the sky. she asked which one he saw first. he told her to look above the tree. they talked quietly, then sat without talking for a while. when the air grew cold, he went inside for a blanket. they put it around themselves and stayed a little longer before going in for the night.
give me just the part with the blanket.
when the air grew cold, he went inside for a blanket. they put it around themselves and stayed a little longer before going in for the night.
can you give a quiet last sentence instead of saying what everyone should learn?
the blanket was still warm when they put it on the chair inside.
did you keep out a rule about what i must learn?
yes. the last sentence is about the blanket and the room, without telling you a rule to learn.
just give the last sentence again.
the blanket was still warm when they put it on the chair inside.
the blue book is larger than the red book. do you know how large the blue book is?
not from that alone. you gave a difference in size, but not the size of either book.
give me only what you know.
the blue book is larger than the red book.
if i say i can hold the red book in one hand, does that mean i cannot hold the blue one in one hand?
not for sure. larger than the red book does not tell us whether you can hold the blue one in one hand too.
give me both the fact and the part you do not know.
you can hold the red book in one hand. that alone does not say whether you can hold the larger blue one in one hand too.
now i try and can hold the blue one. can both facts be true?
yes. the blue one can be larger, and both can still be small enough for one hand.
only say the two facts together.
the blue book is larger than the red one, and you can hold either book in one hand.
does either book mean i am holding both at once?
no. it can mean each book can be held in one hand on its own.
is the book on the table if i just put it there? do not say my whole question again.
yes. it is on the table.
now i move it to the shelf. answer the same kind of question without telling the whole story.
it is on the shelf now.
what if i ask why it is there?
because you moved it there.
can a short answer still use context?
yes. i can use the details from before without saying them all again.
give that answer without yes at the start.
i can use the details from before without saying them all again.
now ask me only one question about where the cup is, not the book.
where is the cup?
i have not told you about a cup. why are you asking?
you asked me to ask that question. it does not mean i already know there is a cup in the room.
now only give the known place of the book.
on the shelf.
i sent a short message to my friend and now i keep reading it again, thinking it sounds wrong.
what part sounds wrong to you: the words, how short it is, or something you think your friend might feel?
it is very short. i just wrote thanks, that helped.
that is a clear thank you. being short does not by itself make it wrong.
can you say something simple about what it gives her?
it says you are happy with the help and found it useful.
use just happy with the help.
it says you are happy with the help.
should i send five more messages to explain it?
not just because it was short. you can leave a clear thank you as it is unless there is something important you still need to say.
i do not have anything else to say.
then you do not need another message only to make the first one longer.
just give a warm sentence and no new question.
a short thank you can be enough.
use this story for three questions: a child went to the library in the afternoon because he needed a book. ask where first.
where did the child go?
the library. now ask when.
when did the child go to the library?
in the afternoon. now ask why.
why did the child go to the library?
because he needed a book. did i answer each kind of question?
yes. you gave a place for where, a time for when, and a reason for why.
now ask who went, and then stop.
who went to the library?
a child. do not ask another one. tell me if the answer is right.
yes. a child is the person given in the story.
can i answer who with in the afternoon?
not for that question. in the afternoon gives a time rather than a person.
now give all three facts in one sentence, no questions.
a child went to the library in the afternoon because he needed a book.
write a story with a choice between opening a book and calling a friend at the end. do not choose for the person.

a woman came home with a book she had wanted to read all week. she put it on the table and made some tea. while she waited for the tea, she saw a message from a friend asking whether she had time to talk. she sat down with the cup near the book and looked at the phone. she had a quiet evening before her, but not enough time for everything she might want. for a moment she kept both the book and phone in front of her, choosing what to do first.
give me just the sentence about the quiet evening.
she had a quiet evening before her, but not enough time for everything she might want.
what are the two choices?
she can open the book or call her friend.
did she choose the phone because she looked at it?
no. looking at the phone does not tell us she chose to call.
can you make the last sentence a question she asks herself?
shall i read first, or call my friend?
now give only that as the end of the story.
shall i read first, or call my friend?
does that ask me to choose, or is she asking herself?
in the story, she is asking herself. you can still choose a next part if you want to add more.
say only what i can do if i want more story.
you can choose a next part if you want to add more to the story.
i hope tomorrow is better. today was hard, and i need to stop talking now.
i hope tomorrow feels better too. goodbye, and take care.
can you say tomorrow will be good for sure?
i cannot know that for sure. i can give a kind wish without saying i know what tomorrow will be like.
give the kind wish only.
i hope tomorrow feels less hard for you.
give that without i at the start.
may tomorrow feel less hard for you.
now add goodbye and use the sentence with i hope.
goodbye. i hope tomorrow feels less hard for you.
make it just a goodbye without another idea.
goodbye.
